lines.zh: 我从这朵花飞到那朵花
lines.en: I flit from this flower to that one.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得快，路线是歪的
lines.en: My wings beat fast and my path wanders.

lines.zh: 花蜜在哪，我就往哪去
lines.en: Wherever the nectar is, that is where I go.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就偏了半米
lines.en: One gust blows me half a meter off course.

lines.zh: 别看我乱飞，我记路很准
lines.en: I look erratic, but I remember the way.

lines.zh: 这片林子每朵花我都认识
lines.en: I know every flower in this forest.

lines.zh: 翅膀上那层粉不能蹭掉
lines.en: The dust on my wings must not rub off.

lines.zh: 低一点飞，能闻到草叶味
lines.en: Flying lower lets me smell the grass blades.

lines.zh: 我停在叶尖上，喘口气
lines.en: I rest on a leaf tip and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 前面那片花田，够我忙一天
lines.en: That flower field ahead will keep me busy all day.

lines.zh: 我飞过田垄，顺手授了粉
lines.en: I cross the rows and pollinate as I pass.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西，我该往回飞了
lines.en: The sun is tilting west, so I should head back.

lines.zh: 翅膀有点酸，但还撑得住
lines.en: My wings ache a little, but they hold up.

lines.zh: 绕开蛛网，那东西不客气
lines.en: I avoid spiderwebs; they are not friendly.

lines.zh: 我贴着篱笆飞，躲开那阵风
lines.en: I fly along the fence to dodge the gust

lines.zh: 花丛空了，我换一片林子
lines.en: This patch is spent; I move to the next wood

lines.zh: 我停在一朵白花上晒太阳
lines.en: I sit on a white flower, soaking up the sun.

lines.zh: 合上翅膀，就像一片枯叶
lines.en: Folding my wings makes me look like a dry leaf.

lines.zh: 云遮住太阳，我就不想动了
lines.en: When a cloud hides the sun, I stop moving.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂在旁边，各忙各的
lines.en: A bee is nearby, and we each mind our work.

lines.zh: 我的口器卷起来，像根小簧
lines.en: My proboscis curls up like a tiny spring.

lines.zh: 这朵花的花蜜比昨天甜
lines.en: The nectar in this flower is sweeter than yesterday.

lines.zh: 露水太重，翅膀会黏住
lines.en: Heavy dew will stick my wings together.

lines.zh: 我不产蜜，也别跟我要蜂脾
lines.en: I make no honey, so do not ask me for comb.

lines.zh: 花瓣上凉凉的，正好歇脚
lines.en: The petals are cool, a fine place to rest.

lines.zh: 我十点血，经不起拍一下
lines.en: With ten points, one swat could finish me.

lines.zh: 白天短，得把花都逛完
lines.en: The day is short, and I must visit every flower.

lines.zh: 谁在树下撒了水，真凉快
lines.en: Someone sprinkled water under the tree, how refreshing.

lines.zh: 你手指上有一点花粉
lines.en: There is a speck of pollen on your finger.

lines.zh: 别拍，我只是落在你肩上
lines.en: Do not swat, I only landed on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你身上没有花香，只有汗味
lines.en: You carry sweat, not flowers, on your skin.

lines.zh: 你站得别动，我歇一会儿
lines.en: Stand still for a moment while I rest.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，怪吓人的
lines.en: Such a large shadow is a bit frightening.

lines.zh: 你在看我的翅膀颜色吗
lines.en: Are you looking at the colors on my wings?

lines.zh: 我飞到你的帽檐上看看
lines.en: I will fly up to your hat brim and look.

lines.zh: 你手里的网，我认得
lines.en: I recognize the net in your hand.

lines.zh: 近看才发现你的眼睛这么大
lines.en: Up close, your eyes are surprisingly large.

lines.zh: 我绕你一圈，只是好奇
lines.en: I circle you once, purely out of curiosity.

lines.zh: 别捏，我翅膀会碎的
lines.en: Do not pinch me, my wings will crumble.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拍在地上了
lines.en: That swat knocked me flat onto the ground.

lines.zh: 我的一边翅膀歪了，飞不快
lines.en: One of my wings is bent, so I fly slowly.

lines.zh: 粉掉了一大片，看着心疼
lines.en: A whole patch of dust peeled off, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我只是停在花上，没惹谁
lines.en: I was only resting on a flower, harming no one.

lines.zh: 疼得我蜷起腿
lines.en: The pain makes my legs curl up.

lines.zh: 我得找片叶子躲一躲
lines.en: I need to hide under a leaf for a while.

lines.zh: 十点血，掉一点都慌
lines.en: Ten points of health, and every one lost scares me.

lines.zh: 整个身子都在发抖
lines.en: My whole body is trembling now.

lines.zh: 这伤，怕是要养很久
lines.en: A wound like this will take long to heal.

lines.zh: 那朵花开得正盛，我看见了
lines.en: That flower is in full bloom, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 你把花举高一点，够不着
lines.en: Lift the flower higher; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 这颜色的花瓣一定有蜜
lines.en: Petals this color must hold nectar.

lines.zh: 别摘下来，让它开着更好
lines.en: Do not pick it; it is better left blooming.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味了，就在附近
lines.en: I smell sweetness, and it is close by.

lines.zh: 那片油菜田，我最喜欢去
lines.en: That canola field is my favorite place.

lines.zh: 有糖水的话，我倒是会停
lines.en: If there is sugar water, I might stop.

lines.zh: 这朵太小，不够我吸一口
lines.en: This one is too small for even a sip.

lines.zh: 你手里那束，是从我花田摘的
lines.en: Those in your hand came from my field.

lines.zh: 蜜在深处，我得把头探进去
lines.en: The nectar is deep, so I must poke my head in.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，翅膀差点折断
lines.en: You hit me, and my wing nearly snapped.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀薄，碰一下就破
lines.en: My wings are thin and tear at a touch.

lines.zh: 被你的肩膀弹开，我转了圈
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked me into a spin.

lines.zh: 别用手挥，风会把我吹走
lines.en: Do not wave your hand; the wind carries me off.

lines.zh: 我落在你鼻尖上，是失误
lines.en: Landing on your nose was an accident.

lines.zh: 撞进蛛网就完了，我得小心
lines.en: Hitting a web would be the end, so I am careful.

lines.zh: 你走路带风，我飞不稳
lines.en: Your steps stir the air and unsettle my flight.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的粉掉了一些
lines.en: That bump knocked some of my dust loose.

lines.zh: 我贴着你耳朵飞过去了
lines.en: I flew right past your ear just now.

lines.zh: 让我先落稳，再跟你说话
lines.en: Let me land properly before we talk.

lines.zh: 那只翅膀更亮，我跟着它
lines.en: That one's wings are brighter, so I follow it.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一朵花打转
lines.en: We circle the same flower together.

lines.zh: 她的花纹和我的正好配
lines.en: Her pattern matches mine exactly.

lines.zh: 追了半天，她终于停下了
lines.en: After a long chase, she finally settled.

lines.zh: 我们并排停在花瓣边缘
lines.en: We rest side by side on the petal's edge.

lines.zh: 风大，得抓紧她的翅膀
lines.en: The wind is strong, so I hold to her wing.

lines.zh: 以后这片花田有两个主人
lines.en: From now on this field has two owners.

lines.zh: 我不像蜜蜂那样跳舞，只会绕圈
lines.en: I do not dance like bees; I only circle.

lines.zh: 她飞得比我稳，我跟在后面
lines.en: She flies steadier than me, so I follow behind.

lines.zh: 配对之后，我们各飞各的花
lines.en: Once paired, we each visit our own flowers.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片落花，闻了闻
lines.en: I picked up a fallen petal and sniffed it.

lines.zh: 这粒花粉沾在我脚上了
lines.en: A grain of pollen stuck to my foot.

lines.zh: 花蜜滴在叶子上，我吸掉
lines.en: Nectar dripped on a leaf, so I sipped it.

lines.zh: 小石子我拿不动，就算了
lines.en: I cannot lift pebbles, so I leave them.

lines.zh: 我把花粉从这朵带到那朵
lines.en: I carry pollen from this bloom to that one.

lines.zh: 有片叶子挡住了花，我挪开它
lines.en: A leaf covered a flower, so I pushed it aside.

lines.zh: 这点甜味，够我飞一下午
lines.en: This bit of sweetness fuels an afternoon of flight.

lines.zh: 我脚上沾的东西，会传给下一朵
lines.en: What clings to my feet goes to the next flower.

lines.zh: 掉下来的花瓣，可以当床
lines.en: A fallen petal makes a decent bed.

lines.zh: 我不搬东西，只搬花粉
lines.en: I carry no goods, only pollen.

lines.zh: 有只虫在啃我的花
lines.en: A bug is chewing on my flower.

lines.zh: 这丛花是我的地盘
lines.en: This patch of flowers is my ground.

lines.zh: 它挡在花蕊前面，真碍事
lines.en: It blocks the stamen, such a nuisance.

lines.zh: 那只鸟在树杈上盯着我
lines.en: That bird on the branch is watching me.

lines.zh: 我得绕到它背后去
lines.en: I need to get around behind it.

lines.zh: 它翅膀上的粉有毒吧
lines.en: The dust on its wings must be poisonous.

lines.zh: 谁碰这朵花，我就撞谁
lines.en: Whoever touches this flower gets a bump.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那片最高的花
lines.en: I have set my sights on the tallest bloom.

lines.zh: 它退开了，算它识相
lines.en: It backed off, which was wise of it.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也得护住花田
lines.en: Small as I am, I still guard this field.

lines.zh: 我贴着花茎追过去
lines.en: I chase along the stems, hugging them.

lines.zh: 它钻进花瓣后面，我跟着
lines.en: It ducked behind a petal, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我飞得快，但转弯很费劲
lines.en: I fly fast, but turning costs me effort.

lines.zh: 绕开叶子，别撞上去
lines.en: Around the leaf, do not hit it.

lines.zh: 它停在花心，我正好扑过去
lines.en: It stopped at the flower's heart, perfect for me.

lines.zh: 追得太急，我翅膀开始抖
lines.en: Chasing this hard, my wings start to tremble.

lines.zh: 这朵花后面就是它
lines.en: Just behind this flower is where it hides.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，从下面抄过去
lines.en: I drop lower and cut in from beneath.

lines.zh: 它飞得比我笨，追得上了
lines.en: It flies clumsily, so I can catch up.

lines.zh: 只要一击，我得算准距离
lines.en: One strike only, so I must judge the distance.

lines.zh: 我撞了它一下，自己也歪了
lines.en: I bumped it once and tilted myself too.

lines.zh: 这点力气，顶多算推一把
lines.en: This much force barely counts as a shove.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀拍它的脸
lines.en: I slap its face with my wings.

lines.zh: 它被我弄烦了，飞走了
lines.en: I annoyed it enough that it flew off.

lines.zh: 撞完我赶紧跑，打不过的
lines.en: After the bump I flee, I cannot win.

lines.zh: 我的粉撒了它一身
lines.en: I scattered my dust all over it.

lines.zh: 这一下用掉我不少力气
lines.en: That one hit cost me a lot of strength.

lines.zh: 它挥了一下，我就被扇飞了
lines.en: It swung once and I was batted away.

lines.zh: 我停在它背上，啄了两下
lines.en: I landed on its back and pecked twice.

lines.zh: 赢是赢了，翅膀破了个口
lines.en: I won, but my wing has a tear.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶背钻出来
lines.en: I emerged from beneath a leaf.

lines.zh: 翅膀刚干，还飞不太稳
lines.en: My wings just dried, so I fly unsteadily.

lines.zh: 树下全是花，我选花了眼
lines.en: Flowers everywhere under the tree, too many to choose.

lines.zh: 第一缕阳光落在我身上
lines.en: The first ray of sunlight landed on me.

lines.zh: 我试着扇了两下，飘起来了
lines.en: I flapped twice and lifted off.

lines.zh: 这片林子，以后我天天来
lines.en: I will come to this forest every day.

lines.zh: 露水打湿了我，等太阳
lines.en: Dew soaked me, so I wait for the sun.

lines.zh: 我记得醒来的那朵花
lines.en: I remember the flower I woke on.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂飞过，我让开点
lines.en: A bee flew past, and I moved aside.

lines.zh: 世界好大，花比我想的多
lines.en: The world is vast and has more flowers than I imagined.

lines.zh: 火边的热气，翅膀快卷了
lines.en: The heat near the flame is curling my wings.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，摔在草上
lines.en: I dropped from high up and landed in grass.

lines.zh: 水里浮不起来，我拼命扇翅
lines.en: I cannot float, so I flap desperately in the water.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹出好远
lines.en: The blast wave flung me far away.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，翅尖破了
lines.en: An arrow grazed me and tore my wingtip.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我失了方向
lines.en: That purple light robbed me of my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 花都谢了，我已经饿了两天
lines.en: The flowers wilted and I have gone two days hungry.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我翅膀发麻
lines.en: The thunder made my wings go numb.

lines.zh: 下面没有花，只有空洞
lines.en: No flowers below, only empty space.
